metadata.name: SaaS Free Trial Length Test (14 vs 30 Days)
metadata.description: Tests extending the free trial from 14 to 30 days to increase trial-to-paid conversion. Larger companies need longer evaluation cycles and benefit significantly; small startups see minimal lift.
metadata.what_is_interesting: Clean experiment (no SRM, stable novelty) that showcases strong company-size HTE: enterprises (>50 seats) convert 8pp more with the longer trial, while small teams show negligible change.

key_insights: Data quality checks passed — all four validity checks are clean.
Effect is stable. Safe to make shipping decision.

Strongest treatment modifier: company_size (ATE=+0.0344, stability=0.92). Target top 20% of users by predicted lift (ITE ≥ 0.076); expected lift for this segment: +0.144 driven by company_size_x_treat. Overall ATE: +0.034.
ml_result.recommendation: Results are reliable. Proceed with shipping decision.

hte.business_recommendation: Target top 20% of users by predicted lift (ITE ≥ 0.076); expected lift for this segment: +0.144 driven by company_size_x_treat. Overall ATE: +0.034.

segments.overall_recommendation: Roll out to segments 1, 4. Investigate segments 0, 2, 3 (inconclusive). Overall ATE: +0.034.

segments.description: Segment 0: mid-sized group (19% of users) with company_size below average (29.23 vs 40.49). Lift: +0.019 (not significant).
Segment 1: mid-sized group (24% of users) with company_size below average (27.68 vs 40.49). Lift: +0.054 (significant).
Segment 2: small group (5% of users) with company_size above average (213.24 vs 40.49). Lift: +0.051 (not significant).
Segment 3: mid-sized group (20% of users) with usage_score above average (48.96 vs 28.36). Lift: +0.023 (not significant).
Segment 4: mid-sized group (32% of users) with company_size below average (27.07 vs 40.49). Lift: +0.034 (significant).

anomaly.recommendation: Results are valid. Proceed with analysis.
